landing.description: ChronoFeed brings together the news that matters to you from across the web and organizes it into personalized feeds.

personalized.title: Create your own personalized feeds
personalized.body: Use keywords to gather news on the subjects that interest you and follow exactly what you want to know.

adFree.title: No ads
adFree.body: A clean read, focused entirely on the news itself.

timeline.title: On your time
timeline.body: Updates arrive straight to your timeline.

landing.signInHint: Sign in to start building your feed.

auth.devLoginFailed: Dev login failed. Is the API running in development mode?

createFeed.title: Create a feed
createFeed.body: Choose keywords that describe the subject you want to follow.

gather.title: We gather the news
gather.body: ChronoFeed searches the sources and collects what matches your keywords.

read.title: Read on your time
read.body: New articles show up on your timeline, with an indicator for what you haven't read.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHelp: Language articles are translated to. Disabled = no translation.
preferences.saveError: Could not save your preferences. Please try again.

feed.noArticles: No articles in this feed yet.
feed.limitReached: You can have at most {{max}} feeds.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete feed?
deleteConfirm.body: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: You don't have any feeds yet
empty.body: Create a feed to start seeing your personalized news.

reorderFeeds.title: Reorder feeds
reorderFeeds.hint: Drag to reorder your feed tabs.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the feed.
errors.limit: You've reached the maximum number of feeds.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.body: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again soon.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
